description: Say whether a number is good: returns the band (e.g. "Healthy", "Below target"), the target range and what it means, for LTV:CAC, CAC payback, churn, NRR, GRR, Rule of 40, Magic Number, burn multiple, quick ratio, gross margin, ROAS, conversion rate, marketing budget % of revenue and NPS.
